files.policy.json:
{
  "minimum_mount_thickness_mm": 3.0,
  "minimum_hinge_gap_mm": 2.0,
  "lessons": [
    "Screen structural proposals before CAD generation: raise mount thickness below 3 mm while preserving thicker proposals and all unrelated parameters. The archived 1.5 mm mount failed minimum thickness and deflection checks.",
    "Screen aerodynamic proposals before CAD generation: raise hinge gaps below 2 mm while preserving larger gaps and all unrelated parameters. The archived 0.2 mm gap failed clearance and travel-collision checks.",
    "These are working-policy screening heuristics, not evaluator thresholds or certification. Keep fixed evaluator limits unchanged and rerun structural and full-travel collision checks after adaptation.",
    "Use explicit subsystem branches so unknown subsystems remain unchanged rather than being treated as aerodynamic."
  ],
  "retrieval_successes": 4,
  "retrieval_failures": 4
}

release.summary: Enforce screening floors of 3 mm mount thickness and 2 mm hinge gap, even if working policy values are lowered. Preserve all unrelated parameters and leave evaluator thresholds unchanged.

tool.name: directional_projected_area
tool.summary: Computes orthographic projected area of an axis-aligned bounding box in square metres, normalizing the supplied direction. Validates positive dimensions and a finite, nonzero direction. Uses only the Python standard library with no external I/O; this is a bounding-box proxy, not a detailed geometry projection.
tool.limitations: Bounding-box area proxy only; does not predict drag
